Gideon Sato, I've posted the Hartford incident summary draft as a reply to your message in #strategic-random. I built it from #inc-vtg-hartford, where you're a member. These are the three times you asked for, all from 3 Aug 2026:

- **First report:** 10:42 AM. Both gate kiosk lanes were showing a white screen.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM.
- **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM.

The draft also mentions ticket INC-4821. It says the issue was gate check-in only, and that Mateo's status-page access problem was still open at the last update.

The incident channel doesn't state a time zone, so the draft says the times are as shown there. If you know the zone, add it before you send the summary.

I didn't send anything to Mateo's team, because any mail to an address outside pemberline.com needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. Tell me if you want me to start that.
